entities.summary: The Monastery of Saint Minas is a former Armenian monastery in eastern Turkey which has been in use until the Armenian genocide. It's a dome-less basilica with columns. Located at the western edge of Gezköy village of Erzurum province in Turkey now. The village of Gezköy is about 9 km west of the centre of the city of Erzurum.
